title: metadata: an action saved through the metadata door keeps `requiresFeature` / `requiresMembershipReach` raw — never lowered into `visible` — so the button shows to everyone (save-door sibling of #25744)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The two gates are a parse transform into `visible`; the metadata save path stores the input without that transform, so a gated action is offered to users who lack the feature or the membership grade.

## Reproduction

1. On `gapdata_order`: action `sso_only` with `requiresFeature: "ssoEnforced"` (false in `/auth/config`) and action `owner_only` with `requiresMembershipReach: "delete_organization"`; save via Studio or `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/…?mode=draft`, publish.
2. As a plain member: both buttons are shown. Repeated on `open_docs` / `open_form` with the same result.

## Expected

Every door that stores an action applies the same lowering (or refuses), so the declared gate is enforced in the console.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (~lines 2263-2269, the lowering transform) vs the metadata save path that stores unparsed input — same class as closed #25744 (raw manifest / strict:false path).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio + console, measured twice by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: A declared capability that the runtime does not honour is exactly what the "declared ⇒ enforced" rule forbids; members see actions meant for owners.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:spec`, `area:records`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `action requiresFeature requiresMembershipReach not enforced button visible to everyone` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 2 hits, both closed (#25744 the raw-manifest sibling, #21795 the feature request).
- QA id: G7
